title: Accounts Receivable Assistant Hybrid 6 month contract
description:
JOB TITLE: Accounts Receivable Assistant

LOCATION: Ashford, Kent (3 days WFH)

SALARY: £14.50ph

HOURS: 8.30am to 5pm, M-F (3pm finish on a Friday!)

Office Angels are proud to be recruiting this fantastic opportunity for a Global company based in Ashford. Our client is a leader in its sector and you will be based in modern offices close to the M20 offering an excellent working environment with free fruit, pastries and snacks for staff. This role is working as a part of a large Finance team where you will be supported in your role, once trained you also have the flexibility to work from home 3 days a week with an early 3pm finish on a Friday!

This is a temporary starting immediately for 6 months, however there could be further opportunities.

The day to day duties in your new job would be:
- Ensuring customers payments are received in accordance to agreed payment terms
- Acting as a point of contact for customers to resolve invoice issues and collect payments
- Liaising effectively with Commercial, Customer Service and Finance teams
- Bank Reconciliation for incoming cash
- Applying payments, debit and credit memos to customer accounts
- Assisting with month-end close process for receivables (Bank Reconciliation and AR balances reconciliation)
- Processing customers rebates and manual credit notes
- Preparing Accounts Receivable Monthly Analysis
- Preparing of the Quarterly Bad Debt accrual
- Other accounts duties as required

We'd love to speak to candidates who:
- Have Accounts Receivable/Credit Control/Finance experience
- Have strong attention to detail
- Are available immediately and are committed to starting a new role

AMAZING Benefits of becoming an Office Angels Temp:
- Weekly Pay
- Up to 28 days annual leave
- Dedicated consultant to support your job search
- First opportunity to see permanent positions
- Access to free eyecare vouchers
- Temp of the Month awards
- Timesheets can be completed on mobile devices
- Perks at work
- Discount schemes
- Access to Well-being platforms

Next steps

If you're interested in this position and have the skills and attributes listed above then please apply today.

Please note if you're suitable and your skills match the role you'll receive an e-mail from us. Remember to call us on ASAP/within 24 hours to discuss the position in further detail with Poppy or Lindsay. We look forward to your application. This is a Temporary role starting immediately so please only apply if you can start work within a few days' notice.

title: Sales Executive
description:
Sales Executive

Progression to Field Sales in the future

30- 36,000, Uncapped Commission

Location: Ashford, Kent

Monday-Friday, 9am-5.30pm

Permanent, Full-Time

Ready to build a career in sales? - Love talking to people? Competitive, ambitious and motivated by earning potential? This is your opportunity to build a long-term career in sales with an established software business.

We're looking for a confident, driven individual to join the team, starting with outbound sales calls and appointment setting before progressing towards running your own sales calls and meeting customers face-to-face.

What's on offer?
- 30,000 basic salary
- Uncapped sales commission
- Full training and daily coaching
- Supportive, experienced sales team
- Structured development over 12-18 months
- Genuine opportunity to progress into field sales
- Long-term career opportunities in software and technology sales

What will you be doing?
- Making high-volume outbound sales calls to prospective business customers.
- Booking quality appointments for the sales team.
- Learning the software, products and solutions you'll be selling.
- Developing your sales skills through real customer conversations.
- Understanding customer challenges and identifying sales opportunities.
- Keeping CRM records accurate and following up with prospects.
- Taking part in daily coaching, call reviews and ongoing sales training.
- Your route into field sales

Over your first 12-18 months, you'll learn the product, understand customer needs and hone your sales skills with hands-on training and regular coaching.

As your confidence and experience grow, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of your own sales calls, build customer relationships and progress towards face-to-face field sales.

What we're looking for
- A confident communicator who enjoys talking to people.
- Ambition, resilience and a strong work ethic.
- Motivation to achieve targets and earn commission.
- A willingness to learn, take feedback and improve.
- An interest in sales, technology and helping businesses find solutions.
- Previous telesales, outbound calling or customer-facing experience is beneficial.

You don't need field sales experience. We'll teach you the product and sales techniques. We want someone with the drive to succeed and the ambition to build a career.

Ready to take the next step? - If you're looking for more than just a job and want to develop into a field sales professional, earn uncapped commission and build a long-term career, apply today!

Learn. Earn. Develop. Build your future in sales. APPLY TODAY - Interviews starting 19.10.2026

title: Sales Support Executive
company: Diamond Search Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Commercial Support Executive (Sales Support)

Diamond Search Recruitment representing our confidential client

Location: Ashford, Kent
Salary: £35,000 per annum + bonus scheme
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am 5:00pm
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Working Arrangement: Fully office-based

The Opportunity

Diamond Search Recruitment is delighted to be representing an innovative and growing business in the recruitment of a Commercial Support Executive.

This is an exciting opportunity for an organised, commercially minded individual who enjoys working with systems, technology and people and who wants to build a genuine career within sales and business development.

You will work closely alongside a Senior Business Development Manager, forming a two-person commercial team. While the Senior BDM focuses on customer relationships, commercial conversations and closing opportunities, you will take ownership of the detail, systems, administration and follow-through that keep opportunities progressing.

This is far more than a traditional administration role. You will have regular exposure to customers, sales meetings and live commercial opportunities, with a clear opportunity to develop your skills and progress into a more senior commercial position over time.

What Will You Be Doing?

Supporting the Senior Business Development Manager
- Work closely with a Senior BDM as their dedicated commercial support.
- Manage administration, inboxes, actions and technical details to keep opportunities moving.
- Prepare documents, information and materials ahead of customer meetings.
- Keep live opportunities organised, accurate and progressing.
- Identify opportunities to improve processes and make the sales journey more efficient.

CRM, Systems & AI
- Maintain CRM and project management systems accurately and consistently.
- Ensure customer records, opportunities, actions and follow-ups are kept fully up to date.
- Use AI tools, automation and digital workflows to reduce repetitive administration.
- Help develop smarter processes and workflows across the commercial function.
- Maintain a high level of accuracy across pricing information, documentation, timelines and customer data.

Customer-Facing Responsibilities
- Attend customer video calls and meetings alongside the Senior BDM.
- Travel to customer meetings when required.
- Listen carefully, capture important information and contribute to commercial discussions.
- Help ensure customers receive a professional, knowledgeable and joined-up experience.
- Build your understanding of the sales process through direct exposure to customers and opportunities.

Your Development
- Receive training and exposure to the commercial process, products and customer journey.
- Develop your understanding of sales, business development and commercial operations.
- Take on greater responsibility as your knowledge and confidence develop.
- Work towards a potential progression route into a more senior commercial/sales position.

About You

We're looking for someone who is organised, commercially curious and highly detail-focused.

You might currently be working in a sales support, sales administration, commercial administration, customer service, project coordination or similar role or you may already have some experience in a sales environment and be looking for your next step.

Most importantly, you'll enjoy working with people and systems.

You'll be someone who:
- Has excellent attention to detail and takes pride in getting things right.
- Is confident using CRM systems and/or project management platforms.
- Is genuinely interested in AI, automation and finding smarter ways of working.
- Has strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Is comfortable joining customer calls and meetings.
- Can manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy.
- Is proactive and enjoys spotting ways to improve processes.
- Works well as part of a close-knit, high-performing team.
- Has an interest in developing a career within sales and commercial roles.
- Is confident learning new software and specialist systems.
- Is reliable, organised and comfortable working at pace.

What's In It For You?

£35,000 basic salary + bonus scheme

Bonus linked to shared monthly and quarterly team milestones.

Work directly alongside an experienced Senior Business Development Manager.

Genuine exposure to live customers and commercial opportunities.

A clear opportunity to develop towards a more senior sales/commercial position.

A technology-focused environment where AI and automation are actively encouraged.

Training and development within an exciting and growing sector.

The opportunity to work with ambitious brands across the health, wellness and nutrition market.

The Working Environment

This is a fully office-based position in Ashford, working Monday to Friday, 9:00am 5:00pm.

You'll be joining a modern, commercially focused environment where technology, AI and efficient systems are central to the way the team operates.

Interested?

If you're looking for a role that combines commercial exposure, customer interaction, technology and career development, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today through Diamond Search Recruitment.

title: Receptionist
description: Practice Plus Group are looking for a Bank Receptionist at our Surrey OOH service to prepare and open a centre for patients, doctors and nurses arrival and ensure patients are seen in a professional manner following the guidelines issued by Practice Plus Group. Our OOH service is open from 19.00-08.00 Monday to Friday and 24 hours over the weekend. We can offer a range of sessions to allow you to flexibly choose the right shift pattern for you. The location for this role is Ashford Hospital, Stanwell, Ashford, TW15 3AA At Practice Plus Group, were here to make healthcare betterfor patients, clinicians and everyone in between. As one of the UKs largest independent providers of NHS services, we offer consistent, high-quality care through our urgent treatment centres, walk-in clinics, and GP practices. Our Out of Hours Receptionists ensure that even when most of the world has switched off, care continues seamlessly. With a bank contract, youll have the flexibility to pick up shifts that suit your schedule while contributing to a team that truly values compassion and reliability. Youll be the welcoming presence and organised mind that helps keep things running smoothly during our out-of-hours services. Your responsibilities will include: Greeting patients warmly and registering them efficiently Managing telephone enquiries, bookings and patient queries Supporting clinical teams by coordinating patient flow Handling data entry and maintaining accurate records Ensuring the reception area is calm, tidy and professional Adapting quickly to changing demands during busy periods Every shift brings a new set of challenges, and your flexibility will help us meet them with confidence.
